title: Green Car Reports - 2026 Genesis Electrified GV70 preview
notes: Relays Genesis: 2026 Electrified GV70 has an 84 kWh pack (up from 77.4 kWh on the 2025 model), a NACS port with native Supercharger access, 10-80 % in about 20 min (2025 car: about 18 min with a CCS adapter). No usable or DC peak.
